parameters.name: CallbackOnlyHasObject
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter callback messages. Valid values:

- true: The callback is triggered only when objects are detected in the input video.
- false: The callback is triggered regardless of whether objects are detected.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The timestamp of the actual start time of the video. For example, if the video starts at 12:00 on August 16, 2021, the corresponding timestamp is 1629086400.

parameters.name: VideoURL
parameters.description: The URL of the video file. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
